The screenplay was written by Tony Kushner and Eric Roth, based on the book "Vengeance" by George Jonas. The film starred Eric Bana, Daniel Craig, Ciarán Hinds, and Geoffrey Rush, among others. "Munich" received critical acclaim and was nominated for several Academy Awards, including Best Picture and Best Director.
